title: Crusoe to buy about $400M of AMD MI355X chips

sources.quote: Cherney SAN FRANCISCO (Reuters) -Crusoe CEO Chase Lochmiller said on Thursday the artificial intelligence data center builder planned to purchase roughly $400 million worth of AI chips from Advanced Micro Devices to add to its portfolio of computing power.

explain: Crusoe, which rents AI computing to customers, said it planned to buy about $400M of AMD's MI355X chips (roughly 13,000) for a new US data center. The figure came from Crusoe's CEO in a Reuters interview, not a filing.
